summary: Esper draw-go control pairs cheap setup instants with discounted high-value spells, clones Saruman for graveyard theft, and converts second casts, draws, and mill into finite combat, drain, and mill finishes.

tags.name: control
tags.reason: The primary play pattern is holding up interaction and drawing at instant speed.

tags.name: spellslinger
tags.reason: Cantrips, alternative-cost instants, and cast triggers are the operating engine.

tags.name: draw
tags.reason: Independent draw engines, instant refills including Dreams, and Splendor sustain reactive turns.

tags.name: spell copy
tags.reason: Saruman casts copied cards while Storm and Taigam copy spells.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Multiple Sarumans repeatedly use opposing graveyards; Commandeer and Reins provide reactive theft.

tags.name: cantrips
tags.reason: Cheap draw and flash-enabling draw spells set up the second cast.

tags.name: clones
tags.reason: Three dedicated clones multiply Saruman, draw engines, or finishers.

tags.name: counterspells
tags.reason: Four true counterspells provide broad, graveyard-conditional, targeted-protection, and mana-payment coverage.

tags.name: equipment
tags.reason: Staff multiplies creature triggers and Foe-hammer converts creature power into instant/sorcery discounts.

tags.name: flash
tags.reason: Draw-go instants, Gearhulk, and flash-enabling cantrips develop at reactive timing.

tags.name: lifedrain
tags.reason: Onyx, Guildmage, and charged Bloodchief Ascension turn spells or graveyard entries into life loss.

tags.name: mill
tags.reason: Saruman and Tidecaller stock graveyards; Dreams adds a flexible burst for Guildmage and Ascension.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Heart, Typhoon, and Inkshield are combat finishes; Rammas supplies blockers.

tags.name: activated abilities
tags.reason: Guildmage and Water Crystal supply mill mana sinks.

tags.name: aikido
tags.reason: Mirrorweave, Sudden Spoiling, and Reins turn combat plans against their owners.

tags.name: boardwipes
tags.reason: Instant combat resets and Evacuation protect against creature boards.

tags.name: bounce
tags.reason: Combat resets and flexible bounce preserve reactive timing.

tags.name: combo
tags.reason: Guildmage and charged Ascension convert finite mill bursts into lethal life loss.

tags.name: enchantments
tags.reason: Heart, Corrosion, Storm, Rammas, and Monk Class provide persistent payoffs.

tags.name: exile
tags.reason: Saruman, Spelltwine, and suspend provide meaningful casting outside the hand.

tags.name: flying
tags.reason: Shark Typhoon supplies scalable flying threats as a dedicated finish.

tags.name: graveyard
tags.reason: Saruman, Spelltwine, and Gearhulk exploit stocked graveyards.

tags.name: prowess
tags.reason: Heart tokens convert noncreature spell chains into combat damage.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: Seven rocks, two creatures, and Splendor support expensive engines and repeated spells.

tags.name: suspend
tags.reason: Taigam stores second spells for later recasts.

tags.name: treasure
tags.reason: Lotho generates mana from second spells around the table.

tags.name: x spells
tags.reason: Drown in Dreams scales draw and mill with generic discounts; Typhoon has scalable cycling.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.reason: Rocks and Water Crystal are infrastructure and an engine.

tags.name: clues
tags.reason: Lavinia provides delayed card draw.

tags.name: cycling
tags.reason: Raffine’s Tower offers flood insurance.

tags.name: discard
tags.reason: Pitch/discard costs and Frantic Search fuel the graveyard.

tags.name: hand size
tags.reason: Water Crystal scales its activation to the hand.

tags.name: monks
tags.reason: Aligned Heart produces Monk tokens.

tags.name: scry
tags.reason: Opt provides cheap selection.

tags.name: self-mill
tags.reason: Consider and Tidecaller can stock our graveyard.

tags.name: surveil
tags.reason: Consider supports selection and graveyard fuel.

tags.name: tap/untap
tags.reason: Frantic Search and Snap reuse lands.

tags.name: topdeck
tags.reason: Brainstorm, Mystic Sanctuary, and Submerge manipulate library tops.

tags.name: wizards
tags.reason: Several unrelated engine creatures are Wizards.
